title: fix(app-shell): list a report in the index and ⌘K only when the navigation shows the member its entry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8SfRz7pGa2P99NAztqiusfy)_
Fixes #26892

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:应用的「全部报表」页和 ⌘K 面板,现在只列出侧边栏会给当前成员看的导航项所指向的报表;导航没有指到的报表照旧列出。⌘K 面板的导航项(对象、仪表盘、页面、报表)也改用侧边栏同一套成员门控。
- **为什么改**:HotCRM 里销售和客服在「全部报表」里看到导航对他们隐藏的报表(如商机报表),点开只有「没有数据」,误以为没数据。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低到中:只在 `app-shell` 前端过滤,复用侧边栏现成的门控,不新增请求;⌘K 面板原本只看叶子项的 `visible`,现在也看 `requiredPermissions`、能力门控和分组的 `visible`,所以有些成员在面板里看到的项会变少(与侧边栏一致)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`views/appReportIndex.ts` 的 `navigationShowsReport`;`chrome/CommandPalette.tsx` 的 `navItems` 与新的 `AppCommandPaletteBody`;新测试 `AppReportIndex.navGates-26892.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/AppReportIndex.navGates-26892.test.tsx`,预期 16 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**The rule kept.** A report that one or more entries of the app's navigation name is listed by the report index (`/apps/APP/reports`) and by the palette's "reports beyond the navigation" only when the member is shown **at least one** of those entries, under the sidebar's own gates: `navEntriesShownToMember` over `useNavMemberGates()`. An entry hidden by its `visible`, its `requiredPermissions`, a runtime-capability gate (`requiresObject` / `requiresService`), the object-read prune, a group those gates hide, or an API `dataSource` read that has not answered (pending counts as hidden, as in the sidebar) does not count. A report **no** entry names keeps today's read rule alone, so the index stays its only door (the objectui#13020 reason for the index). "At least one, not every": a member shown any entry naming the report can already open it from the sidebar, so hiding it from the index would only remove a second door to something they can reach.

Against the card's three personas: the service agent's four opportunity reports are named by entries the navigation hides from them (`visible: OPPORTUNITY_AUDIENCE`, per the card), so they leave the index and the palette; the sales rep's three case reports leave too when HotCRM's navigation names them behind an audience gate the rep fails, which the card's "sidebar shows 7" reading implies; the marketing user's index already dropped the case reports through the dataset read rule, which is unchanged. HotCRM's source is not in this session's reach: these are readings of the card against the rule, pinned here on fixtures of the same shapes, not a run against the HotCRM seed. A HotCRM report named by **no** entry keeps listing, by design.

Commits, in order:

1. `views/appReportIndex.ts`: new exported `navigationShowsReport(app, gates)`; `useAppReportEntries(app, enabled, gates)` takes the member's gates and filters by it before `mayOpenReport`. `AppReportIndexView` passes `useNavMemberGates()`; the palette passes its gates.
2. `chrome/CommandPalette.tsx` (surface widened by the seat's order amendment): the palette's `navItems` were `flattenNavigation(nav)` filtered by each leaf's own `visible` only, so an entry hidden by `requiredPermissions`, a capability gate or its group's `visible` was still offered through the palette's navigation door, a nav-named report included. They are now `flattenNavigation(navEntriesShownToMember(nav, gates))`. **This also gates the palette's object, dashboard and page entries, and the record-search scope (`searchableObjectNames`, read from `navItems`), the way the sidebar gates them.** The palette's own `useNavVisibility(activeApp)` reader is gone: it now has exactly the one binding reader `useNavMemberGates()` builds. Two doc sentences in `hooks/useNavMemberGates.ts` that named the palette as calling `useNavVisibility` directly are corrected; commit 5 adds an optional parameter to `useNavMemberGates`.
3. The gates are built in a new `AppCommandPaletteBody` wrapper and handed down, `null` in the `studio` scope: that scope has no app and reads nothing until it opens (pinned by `CommandPalette.studioScope-11863`), and building the gates in the shared body read the object list while closed. `useAppReportEntries` answers no entry without gates.
4. Test-only: the new suite's adapter double is typed instead of `any`.
5. `useNavMemberGates` takes an optional app, the frame's by default; the palette passes the app it lists, so Home (expression scope binds no app, palette lists the host app) gates the host app's bindings and package scope. The one existing-export change: an added optional parameter, no behaviour change for any existing caller.

No server change, no new request, no spec change.

## Tests

New `views/__tests__/AppReportIndex.navGates-26892.test.tsx` (18 cases), through the real `MetadataProvider`, `MePermissionsProvider`, `ExpressionProvider` and `I18nProvider`. The package owns Alpha, Beta and Gamma (named by entries) and Delta (named by none), all on a readable dataset, so the navigation is the only gate in play:

- index: Gamma's entry `visible: false`, or `requiredPermissions` the member lacks, or inside a `visible: false` group, or bound to an API read still pending ⇒ Alpha, Beta, Delta; controls: the permission granted, `visible: true`, a second shown entry beside a hidden one, and a navigation naming no report ⇒ all four;
- palette, both doors: the same `visible: false`, pending, `requiredPermissions` and hidden-group cases ⇒ no Gamma; the granted control offers it once; an object entry with `requiredPermissions` the member lacks is not offered;
- one read per binding: with a sidebar stand-in (`useNavMemberGates` + `navEntriesShownToMember`, the sidebar's walk) mounted beside the open palette, an entry's API `dataSource` URL is requested exactly once and both show the entry;
- Home shape (h): the frame's expression scope binds no app (`{}`) while the palette lists the host app with a report entry bound to an API read: the entry is shown once the read answers (`total` 1) and requested exactly once; control: `total` 2 stays hidden.

Changed: `AppReportIndex-13020.test.tsx`'s control "reads the report and dataset lists, never the object registry". Its adapter double now records a package-scoped `getItems` with its scope, because the index's gates read the app's object scope (`object?packageId=…`), the sidebar's own read in the console; the unscoped `object` registry read is still pinned absent, and the scoped read is now pinned present.

## Acceptance notes

- The palette's wider gating (commit 2) is a behaviour change for every palette entry type, not only reports: a member now sees in ⌘K exactly the navigation entries the sidebar shows them. Approved as a bounded in-place fix by the seat (order amendment on the card), in its own commit.
- The index and the palette read the gates' reads (the app's object scope, each entry's API binding) through the same readers as the sidebar; in the console the sidebar is mounted on every app page, so these are not new requests.
- Like the rest of this module, the navigation read is the app's `navigation` (with module contributions merged in); `areas[].navigation` is not walked, so a report named only inside an area is treated as named by no entry, as `appShippedReports` already treats it. Observation only, not measured against a producer.

## Verification

Restored: blob `41159b265975` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. A first attempt was refused by the tool before running (its replacement text already occurred in the file), so it measured nothing.

Restored: blob `2e5450c4f0d7` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

3. `CommandPalette.tsx`: `useNavMemberGates(props.activeApp ?? undefined)` replaced by `useNavMemberGates()` (the palette gating the frame's app): both Home-shape (h) cases red, then restored to the HEAD blob, on `ad2bc8e9`.
